name: StreamLimiter
overview: Limits the number of simultaneous streams per user.
description: A Jellyfin plugin that allows you to limit the number of simultaneous streams per user. Features include a default limit, customizable messages, server-side transcode kill for clients that ignore stop commands, and optional device logout.

versions.changelog:
Jellyfin 12 build of v1.1.0.1 (same changes).
- Fixed plugin failing to load on Jellyfin 10.11.0-10.11.10 ("incompatible version of one of the shared libraries", issue #19): now built against Jellyfin 10.11.0 instead of the latest 10.11.x
- Jellyfin 12 build now targets the final 12.0.0 packages instead of 12.0.0-rc2
- Fixed missing plugin logo (and 404 on disable/uninstall) on Jellyfin 12: the Jellyfin 12 DLL reported version 1.1.0.0 instead of its package version; each build now carries its own version (10.11 = 1.1.0.x, Jellyfin 12 = 1.1.1.x)
- Fixed a crashed client's ghost session getting the user's new, legitimate stream stopped (up to ~10 min lockout): the PlaybackStart limiter now uses the same fresh-check-in, per-device count as the HTTP gate
- Transcode kill no longer falls back to killing every job of the device when the client sent no PlaySessionId
- Custom web message now works on servers with a BaseUrl (the injected script used an absolute /StreamLimit path)

- Fixed plugin failing to load on Jellyfin 10.11.0-10.11.10 ("incompatible version of one of the shared libraries", issue #19): now built against Jellyfin 10.11.0 instead of the latest 10.11.x
- Jellyfin 12 build now targets the final 12.0.0 packages instead of 12.0.0-rc2
- Fixed missing plugin logo (and 404 on disable/uninstall) on Jellyfin 12: the Jellyfin 12 DLL reported version 1.1.0.0 instead of its package version; each build now carries its own version (10.11 = 1.1.0.x, Jellyfin 12 = 1.1.1.x)
- Fixed a crashed client's ghost session getting the user's new, legitimate stream stopped (up to ~10 min lockout): the PlaybackStart limiter now uses the same fresh-check-in, per-device count as the HTTP gate
- Transcode kill no longer falls back to killing every job of the device when the client sent no PlaySessionId
- Custom web message now works on servers with a BaseUrl (the injected script used an absolute /StreamLimit path)
Jellyfin 12 build of v1.1.0.0 (same features — see the 1.1.0.0 entry). Servers pick the right build automatically: 10.11 installs 1.1.0.0, Jellyfin 12 installs 1.1.1.0.

- NEW (BETA): HTTP-level hard block — over-limit streams are rejected before any byte is served; works on every client (Swiftfin, Infuse, external players)
- NEW (BETA): single clean custom message on web clients (replaces the built-in dialog)
- NEW: default max streams for users without an explicit limit
- NEW: config migration from pre-1.1 installs (normalizes legacy entries)
- Fixed silent failure where one invalid config entry disabled every limit (#5/#8/#18)
- Fixed device logout (a session id was passed where an access token was expected)
- Kill transcode jobs of blocked streams; optional device logout
- Admin-only stream limit API; removed Newtonsoft.Json
- Fixed duplicated users in the config page dropdown (#16) and empty popup (#6)

- Updated controller 
- Fixed iOS error 
- Fixed configuration management 
- Add TRY in cancel session
